We're closing out the renewal for Greenleaf's Redwood subscription and our AP team needs the final invoice and a clear VAT attribution statement before we can release payment. Can you confirm:

- Which portion, if any, is subject to EU VAT vs. reverse-charge (we're an Irish entity, VAT ID IE1234567V)
- Preferred remit methods for EUR and USD (SEPA vs. wire) and bank account details
- A PDF we can attach to our records that is "audit-ready" (invoice + VAT residency evidence)

We have a PO (PO# GL-PO-1149) ready to attach once the invoice matches. Happy to set a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We completed the contract true-up and I've attached the final invoice (redwood_invoice_Greenleaf_20261201.pdf) plus our suggested payment instructions (payment_instructions_SEPA_US_wire.txt) and a short VAT residency statement template you can keep for audit (vat_residency_statement_Greenleaf.pdf). Highlights: 

- Final invoice total (post-true-up): EUR 78,450.00 (see line-item breakdown on page 2)
- VAT: Redwood is a US-headquartered provider; for customers in the EU holding a valid VAT ID we apply reverse-charge where appropriate. Based on IE1234567V and the services delivered, we treat this as reverse-charge (no VAT charged on the invoice). The attached VAT statement references the reverse-charge legal note.
- Remit methods: SEPA transfer preferred for EUR (instructions in attachment). We also accept USD wires — note the separate bank details for USD in the attachment.
- PO: please confirm PO# GL-PO-1149 on the invoice PDF and return a copy for our records.

Marissa (cc'd) is handling the ledger posting and will confirm remittance details for SEPA. Karthik, tagging you for any tax residency or VAT evidence we should surface besides the statement.

If everything looks good I can re-issue with the PO number and re-send a DocuSign receipt if needed.

Best,
